resources.string: Each unit keeps its own input. New flow targets start at 1 mL/s. Later flow stages all use flow (1–10 mL/s); first-stage pressure is 0.5–10 bar. Pressure mode supports 0–12 bar. Flow uses 2–4 stages and up to 254 seconds for stage 1; zero water needs a positive stage time. Low-flow preinfusion does not guarantee 0 bar. The curve has no independent pressure ceiling.
Grinder setting, basket, dose, etc. Multiple lines supported.
First stage time (s, flow 0–254, pressure 0–255; 0 uses water amount)
Supports official pressure / flow combinations. Starting still requires confirmation. Target weight and stage water must match machine precision.
Parameters meet local curve start limits

Invalid parameters: name 1–100 characters, temperature 75–105 °C, cup weight 0–200 g. Check target ranges for the selected mode, stage water and time limits (zero water in flow stage 1 needs a positive duration). Description: up to 8000 characters.
Factory and captured curves are saved as local copies, keeping recipe parameters and the curve description.
Shares the name, recipe parameters and curve description. Personal reviews, inventory and raw device records are excluded.
